summary:
Iteration 4: tested admin-UI flow + LLM enrichment block end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 new tests pass (enrichment field present on enriched med, absent on non-enriched, SEO render emits

О препарате

+Показания+Противопоказания+Способ применения, summary used as ; admin list/filter/approve/reject regression). Frontend: /partner-admin without token shows 'Требуется токен'; ?token=WRONG shows 'Неверный токен администратора'; valid token loads 6 'Новые' / 2 'Одобренные' / 3 'Отклонённые' rows; tab filtering works; approve fires API → row leaves 'Новые' & green box with `${origin}/partner-upload?token=…` appears in 'Одобренные' with working 'Скопировать ссылку' button; reject (with confirm) moves row to 'Отклонённые'. /msk/preparaty/paracetamol-… shows enrichment-section with all 4 sub-headings (О препарате, Показания, Противопоказания, Способ применения) + disclaimer. /msk/preparaty/5-nok-… correctly omits the block. Home (2191 chars), catalog (48 links), /dlya-aptek (form rendered) — all regression OK with ZERO console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: PartnerAdmin.jsx: copy button uses navigator.clipboard.writeText with no try/catch and no user feedback — on insecure context or denied permission, the click silently fails. Consider a toast / fallback to document.execCommand for robustness. Low priority.

PartnerAdmin.jsx error display path renders 'Неверный токен администратора' but the page never re-renders the filter UI after the 403, so the operator can't switch tabs to recover without reload. Acceptable for hidden admin tool.

Backend api/seo.py emits enrichment HTML inline — make sure summary/indications/contraindications text is HTML-escaped before interpolation (LLM output is generally safe but defensive escaping is cheap). Could not verify in this run; recommend a quick read by E1.
MedDetail enrichment-section uses data-testid (good). Recommend also adding data-testid to each sub-heading (e.g. 'enrichment-indications') for finer-grained tests.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all targeted flows (admin UI, MedDetail enrichment, regression smoke)

seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_Iter4_Admin (approved) and TEST_Iter4_Reject (rejected) partner_requests. Admin Playwright run also approved TEST_E2E_Chain (left over from iter3) and rejected one prior 'new' row. Net effect on db.partner_requests: 6→4 'new', 2→3 'approved', 3→4 'rejected' (approx).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_enrichment_and_admin.py -v` (9 tests) for enrichment + admin coverage. Combined regression: 39 prior tests in test_partners_and_prefix.py + test_catalog_api.py still pass. Enrichment is on ~200 meds; sample slugs: enriched=paracetamol-10-mg-ml-rastvor-dlya-infuziy, non-enriched=5-nok-50-mg-tabletki-pokrytye-obolochkoy. Admin UI is at /partner-admin?token=… with token in /app/backend/.env; both 403 (bad token) and 200 paths verified. SEO render block uses LLM summary as <meta description>; non-enriched falls back to standard description (no Препарате block).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found in this iteration.
